description: Table of contents of a French code in force (parties, livres, titres, chapitres, sections) with the article numbers under each heading, from DILA's LEGI consolidated base. `depth` controls how many levels come back; pass a `section_id` from a previous answer to expand one branch. Use to browse the structure of the Code civil, Code du travail, Code de commerce, etc., or to list the articles of a chapter.

code.description: The code: its title ("Code civil", "Code du travail", "Code général des impôts"), a short form ("civil", "travail", "CGI", "CPP", "CSP"), or its Légifrance cid (LEGITEXT000006070721).

depth.description: Levels to return below the starting point, 1-8 (default 2).

section_id.description: Optional LEGISCTA id of a section to expand (from a previous fr_code_toc answer).

name: fr_code_toc
title: Fr Code Toc
